2. SNL 3. SNL – West{{efn|Triglav started the season in the [[Slovenian Third League]]. During the winter break, Triglav merged with [[NK Naklo]], who was a member of the [[Slovenian Second League]]. In the second half of the season, a team named Triglav Naklo competed in the Second League, while a team named Naklo Triglav competed in the Third League.
In the next season, re-established Triglav Kranj took Triglav Naklo's place in the Second League, while Naklo Triglav played in the Third League.}}
